name: webmamba/ag-ui-bundle
description: Symfony bundle for AG-UI: every Symfony AI agent speaks the AG-UI protocol, run by the route that picks it. Twig components become generative UI.

suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: To expose Twig components to the model with #[AsAgentComponent].
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: To use the ag-ui and ag-ui-activities Stimulus controllers with AssetMapper.
